bosses.description: After the destruction of the Iguana Mercenaries, Castilla had been looking for an opportunity to counterattack Belsuth, and now Crotti has extended her hand to him.

clues.name: SDF ID Card
clues.subtitle: A document revealing his former identity
clues.text: The ID Card shows a standard rectangular shape, its edges worn and corners slightly curled from frequent handling—a well-preserved memento. Behind the protective plastic window, a slightly faded photo reveals Castilla with a bright, energetic smile, radiating youthful vigor.

clues.name: Warrant
clues.subtitle: A bounty issued by Belsuth City, the once-great Hero, now has a price on their head.
clues.text: A smudged wanted poster bears hasty brushstrokes that capture a once-revered figure on its rough surface. Every mark and number whispers a tale of betrayal and anguish. More than just mockery, this scrap of paper challenges everything he stood for.

clues.name: Duty Log
clues.subtitle: Castilla stalks the Belsuth, chronicling every discovery.
clues.text: The note's well-worn cover and faded edges hint at frequent readings and deep contemplations. Its varied handwriting records the observations and emotions of a city lover, reflecting both helplessness and hope amid the city's changes.

bosses.title: Drink Till Doomsday
bosses.description: No matter how many bottles he gets through, to Mann, the world seems lifeless, empty. He’s made up his mind to change it.

clues.name: Silver-Plated Flask
clues.subtitle: Yesterday brought Brandy, today brings Rum... tomorrow? Let's wing it!
clues.text: The flask boasts intricate silver-plating craftsmanship, blending classical and modern design. Its slender, curved form and smooth surface reflect years of use. The faint scratches on the bottle stopper hint at countless whispered moments of temporary escape, adding character.

clues.name: Talisman
clues.subtitle: A worn talisman from his hometown
clues.text: This talisman, a weathered metal or wooden disc, exudes an ancient aura. Its wear and marks bear the history of numerous hands. Each scratch and abrasion holds a story of belief, nostalgia, or an enduring fixation on the past. Every touch evokes the image of its owner lost in thought, habitually rubbing it.

clues.name: Sunglasses
clues.subtitle: Shades are awesome, perfect for rocking that cool look while keeping your gaze mysterious
clues.text: The sunglasses flaunt trendy brown lenses and a sleek metal frame, blending vintage and modern styles. The slightly tilted lens exudes a cool, mysterious vibe. Each scratch tells an untold story, capturing moments of keen observation while evading the world's scrutiny.

clues.name: Crimson Mask
clues.subtitle: This is his lifelong curse.
clues.text: A dark red mask of heat-resistant alloy bears battle scars and smoke marks, gleaming with an enigmatic sheen. Its integrated filter and breath support system not only purges toxic fumes but enhances daily respiratory function. This permanent fixture is purpose-built for lifelong wear, a common sight among fire-zone survivors with damaged lungs.

clues.name: Matches
clues.subtitle: The pungent smell of sulfur... Ah... That is the smell of life...
clues.text: All-natural wooden matches with sulfur-coated heads and a slightly rough surface for easy ignition through friction. Despite careful preservation by the owner, some of the matches have lost their effectiveness due to being damp for several decades. Despite this, they are silent reminders of their past significance—offering crucial warmth to a child on a cold desert night.

clues.name: Iron Eye Mask
clues.subtitle: A mark of defeat, yet no shame mars his honor.
clues.text: A titanium alloy eye patch covers Blazetrudge's left eye—purely for intimidation. The scar beneath marks his first clash with Grimbite, who breached the fire curtain to land a devastating strike, even before their ST battles began. Rather than opt for a sleek prosthetic, Blazetrudge chose this metal patch to strike fear into his foes.

clues.name: Old Photo
clues.subtitle: No use dwelling on the past.
clues.text: A time-worn photo with a yellow tint and intricate textures displays a faint image of a team, labeled "█ 10th Mobile Squad" on the back. For decades, it lay forgotten in an equipment compartment.

clues.name: Compass
clues.subtitle: As Earth spins onward, this device guides the way.
clues.text: The transparent casing shows hairline cracks, yet the crimson needle remains true north. Though radar dominates ST warfare and soldiers rarely pack compasses anymore, this warrior of yesteryear keeps faith in this classic navigation tool to light his path.

clues.name: Tactical Goggles
clues.subtitle: The barrier stops the sandstorm, but truth finds a way.
clues.text: A retro glass-made Tactical Goggles boasts superior durability and scratch resistance, though its hefty weight led to replacement by modern plastics. While piloting an ST, these vintage specs proved surprisingly effective at blocking intense flashes from railguns and similar weapons, enhancing targeting precision. Sadly, these classic goggles are no longer in circulation.

clues.name: Snowflake Pendant
clues.subtitle: A cheap metal accessory
clues.text: A hexagonal snowflake ornament of aluminum alloy, worn long enough for scratches to mimic corrosion on its surface. On Milkhama, where snow rarely falls, this discontinued piece became a collector's item years ago. Though the givers now rest beneath "The Great Snow," their hopeful wishes live on in the girl's cherished memories.

clues.name: Sedative
clues.subtitle: It disrupts consciousness—exactly what she needs.
clues.text: A quick-relief sleep aid with a 6-hour half-life. While it fights anxiety and seizures, side effects include drowsiness, mood swings, and sluggish reactions. The real danger? Addiction. Quitting brings withdrawal from manic episodes to crushing depression. She knows all this, but can't break free from its grasp.

clues.name: Casket
clues.subtitle: The addiction of collecting only grows stronger, like an endless cycle of hatred.
clues.text: A battered aluminum box rattles and clanks, bearing the scars of countless battles. Inside lies a stack of military badges, trophies claimed from Dawnstar League soldiers. The collector awaits the perfect moment to add a Roarlash badge to her prized collection.

clues.name: Gold Collar Stays
clues.subtitle: Rock that Gold Collar Stay under your shirt and rise to the top!
clues.text: Four gold collar stays glisten in his pocket, for under his collar, just as his father taught: a hallmark of refined gentlemen. A golden collar stay marks true success, they say. He'd often dreamed of that perfect moment: the luxury suit, velvet tie, and those golden stays beneath his collar. But could such finery become his gilded cage? Fate has its own surprising plans.

clues.name: Snuffbox
clues.subtitle: The smell of that home, not this one.
clues.text: A matte dark gold filigree adorned with sapphires masks a crude reality, the powder inside is fit only for low-tier miners. While Garcia's taste might seem questionable, he keeps these personal indulgences to himself. The dreams and memories tied to this scent remain his alone.

clues.name: Milkhaman Eagle
clues.subtitle: He held on with iron resolve until Death's call echoed
clues.text: A large-caliber handgun from the New Gold Rush era, cherished by gun lovers for its raw power and iconic design. A gift from Genovese at their first meeting, Garcia used it to blast through 10 bottles of vintage wine in the cabinet's inner shelf, while leaving the whiskey untouched. "One bottle, 50,000 MHD"... Garcia's memory blurs on whether that sum was his penalty or his prize.

clues.subtitle: Strange graffiti everywhere—a perfect reflection of her wild mercenary days.
clues.text: Mastering the rules is your first step to becoming a rising star! While reality rarely matches expectations, Bertha knows that true warriors excel at adapting. Need tips on adaptability? Check page 56 of the Mercenary Guidebook, which boldly declares, "To adapt, become stronger!" Bertha lives by these words!

clues.name: Knitting Needles
clues.subtitle: Perfect for killing time and kicking butt.
clues.text: A pair of metal knitting needles, one with a deadly point, the other wrapped in delicate thread. During quiet days without missions, Bertha keeps her hands busy with these simple tools. She knits everything from hats and gloves to tiny hamster outfits, weaving her mercenary dreams into each stitch. The orphanage lies in ruins now, and with it, the secret iris pattern the dean once taught her, both lost forever to time.

clues.name: Ahtrea
clues.subtitle: Squeak, squeak, squeak!
clues.text: A hamster with mottled fur of indeterminate breed. Two distinct notches at its mouth corners give it a perpetual smile. Bertha named it Ahtrea, meaning "Best Companion" in hamster-speak. Perhaps blessed with some of Bertha's lucky traits, Ahtrea remains her only "companion" that hasn't met an untimely end.

clues.name: Motorcycle Helmet
clues.subtitle: Life's purpose is right here.
clues.text: Deborah's motorcycle helmet radiates her signature pinkish-purple flair, with traces of her perfume lingering within. The other side bears etched racing records—a chronicle of speed. Although she has clinched many underground racing titles, this helmet, with its runner-up mark, remains her most treasured trophy.

clues.name: Gatling Gun
clues.subtitle: Not the perfect fit, but it'll get the job done
clues.text: She's not exactly a Gatling enthusiast, give her close combat over suppressing fire any day. But duty calls for her to anchor the team's core as their deadliest damage dealer. Whether shielding allies or mowing down enemies, she can't always rein in Vincenza's charges. Still, upholding her authority as leader remains vital to the mission.

clues.name: Motorcycle Key
clues.subtitle: A gateway to a new world beckons.
clues.text: What path would Deborah have chosen without Vincenza, the motorcycle, and that fateful race? She can't say, but knows that every new start comes with its own regrets. Imperfection is reality, just like her runner-up finish... The real victory is embracing destiny's twists and turns along the way.

Probably running errands for someone...

clues.text: In the picture, Hayato is wearing a neat uniform, standing in the middle, with his parents on either side. Slightly in front is his sister, and at the very front is a large white dog. The photo was neatly folded and placed in his chest pocket. On the back of the photo, it reads "Dear Mom, Dad, Sis, and Bobby who's always barking."

clues.text: These two identification tags are made of gold- and silver-colored metallic materials respectively, with personal information such as name, blood type, and service number engraved on the surface. The information is engraved using clear laser technology to ensure readability in various environments. However, the material of one of them seems to be more precious than common stainless steel... The wearer once said that it provides a kind of emergency insurance.

clues.name: A Dose of Antacid
clues.subtitle: Keep drinking and you'll lose your life.

The carrier's ST is equipped with several rows of reserves of this type of medicine, which need to be taken twice a day at regular intervals. Alcohol consumption and overeating increase the frequency at which this medication needs to be taken, so for him, it's practically an after-meal snack...

clues.subtitle: Essential for heavy laborers.
clues.text: This tan sweat-absorbing headband is specifically designed for sports and outdoor activities. Primarily functioning to quickly absorb sweat and keep the head dry and comfortable, it is now used as a neckband. In the past, it accompanied its wearer through physically demanding jobs—hauling cargo, waiting tables, delivering parcels—bringing a welcome sense of freshness. Nowadays, most STs are equipped with air conditioning, but he still wears it to remind himself of how he got here.

clues.name: Mercenary Contract
clues.subtitle: A clarified work relationship.
clues.text: This mercenary contract is a legal document that details the work content, responsibilities, compensation, and other terms between the mercenary and the employer. The contract includes the scope of services, location and duration of tasks, payment details, legal liabilities, a confidentiality agreement, and conditions for contract termination. Additionally, it specifies matters related to casualties, loss handling, and insurance—and this time he was very cautious.

clues.name: Wristband
clues.subtitle: Your body is your capital.
clues.text: This wristband is made of elastic materials like neoprene, providing excellent compression and support while ensuring comfort and breathability. Its main function is to stabilize the wrist joint, prevent sprains and overuse injuries during exercise, and also help alleviate existing pain and discomfort. The heavy labor of the past left a mark on his strong body, and now he has to be a bit more careful.

clues.subtitle: It's pretty intimidating, right?
clues.text: The blade of this dagger is expertly crafted, with a prominent blood groove in the middle to reduce resistance during insertion and withdrawal, making it appear even more intimidating. In terms of intimidation, a knife is often more effective than a gun, as not everyone can imagine the moment they are pierced by a bullet. For this reason, the owner rarely has the opportunity to use this dagger... and that's exactly what he wants.But if and when it does, he's prepared.

clues.name: Knit Cap
clues.subtitle: It's already a bit small for him.
clues.text: This knitted hat is made of soft black wool, providing a warm and comfortable feeling. It shows signs of frequent washing, with the color slightly faded. The red pattern remains vibrant, but the edges of the lines are somewhat worn, giving it a softer appearance, no longer as sharp. This hat accompanied him throughout his childhood, and he will cherish it for the rest of his life. He also wishes that, perhaps, he can use this to hide his baldness in his old age...

Everyone in the squad has one of these dice, and whenever a dispute arises, it's time for the dice to make an appearance. At that moment, fate will guide the squad's direction.
